_why: R418.1 (PACK_P, 116.51,108.75) sits at the west tip of the soft F.Cu PACK_P pour; EN_5V1's only way down the port-1 east column crosses F.Cu right there and cut the pad off (m7), and a hard stub track there (m9) left EN_5V1 with no way. A via in the pad into the In4 PACK_P copy joins the pad without taking the F.Cu crossing.
